ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 嗯。谢谢

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 我吃了抹茶芭菲

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 里面有个有趣的女人

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: ……无趣的女孩子

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 哼……有趣的女孩子

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
下次演出是什么时候？
我要演出

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
我以为它会存在一辈子。
但现在没有了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
不过，她说过，
总会有人再创造新的归宿

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 我可以弹吉他吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 啊，猫。……跑掉了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 想办演出。下次是什么时候？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 春天暖洋洋的，好困

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 在中庭晒太阳的时候，猫跑过来了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 外面好热。RiNG里很凉快，舒服

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 今天很热，所以要吃两个抹茶芭菲

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 秋天很凉快，感觉真好

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 中庭的落叶里有猫。吓我一跳

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 天气冷，不想动。要是演出的话就去

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 被炉里好暖和。今天我要一直待在这里

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 今天是圣诞节。要办圣诞演出吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 新年。外婆收到了好多新年贺卡
